# Glacier Client Config Editor

**This repository is a deploy target — do not edit it directly.**

The source lives in [Glacier-Website](https://github.com/Glacier-Client-BE/Glacier-Website)
under `config/`, and every push to `main` there rebuilds this repository's
tree. Any commit made here is overwritten on the next deploy.

Served at <https://config.glacierclient.xyz>.
